pending_retains_2.content: Hindsight memory system (hindsight.labb.site, fleet-infra ns hindsight, Traefik + authentik-forward-auth) had retain/recall failing with 404 'Not Found'. REAL root cause found 2026-08-06: doubled '/v1/default' prefix — plugin config hindsightApiUrl was 'https://hindsight.labb.site/v1/default' but the SDK @vectorize-io/hindsight-client@0.4.19 naively concatenates baseUrl + endpoint url, and every endpoint already starts with '/v1/default/banks/...', producing 'https://hindsight.labb.site/v1/default/v1/default/banks/{bank_id}/...' -> 404 (reproduced with curl). A bank-id mismatch (derived id 'worldinmovies-mono' vs existing bank 'worldinmovies') was real but secondary. Fix: (1) user created bank 'worldinmovies-mono' server-side; (2) changed ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json hindsightApiUrl to 'https://hindsight.labb.site' (origin only); opencode restart required. Migration: moved all data from bank 'worldinmovies' to 'worldinmovies-mono' via GET/POST /v1/default/banks/{bank_id}/document-transfer (no LLM re-extraction) — 8 documents, 8 facts, 6 observations imported (operation 49d24e7f-e470-4e2b-8c28-db5981e8119b), verified recall returns migrated memories. Auth for direct API: HINDSIGHT_API_TOKEN env (Bearer). fleet-infra issue #567 documents the bug + fix; the api-ingress-route.yaml comment about the plugin URL is misleading (SDK adds /v1/default itself) and should be updated. The old 'worldinmovies' bank is now orphaned (14 units) — kept, not deleted.
